mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.apply_content as applyCotent, a.staff_sattus as staffSattus, a.staff_source as staffSource, b.real_name as realName, b.card_phone as cardPhone, b.card_avatar as cardAvatar, b.industry_first_id as industryFirstId, b.industry_second_id as industrySecondId, b.industry_first_name as industryFirstName, b.industry_second_name as industrySecondName FROM company_staff_record a LEFT JOIN business_card b ON a.staff_card_id = b.card_id WHERE a.staff_source = 0 AND a.staff_sattus = 0 AND a.card_id = '57'
